heading: EPFO Death Claim: A Guide for Families to Claim PF, Pension Online
tldr: Families of deceased EPF members can claim Provident Fund (EPF), pension (EPS), and insurance (EDLI) benefits online.
The online process requires the deceased member's Universal Account Number (UAN) and Aadhaar-linked bank account.
Nominees or legal heirs need to submit specific forms like Form 20, Form 10D, and Form 5IF through the EPFO portal.
Essential documents include the death certificate, Aadhaar of the claimant, and their bank account details.
Proper nomination and KYC compliance of the deceased member significantly expedite the claim settlement process.
caption:
Losing a loved one is incredibly difficult, and sorting out finances can add to the stress. If your family member was an EPF member, there are benefits like PF, pension, and insurance you might be able to claim online. Our new guide makes understanding this process simple, step-by-step. Learn how to navigate the online claim process easily.
